ScoreEntry.title: ScoreEntry
ScoreEntry.description: A single player score record submitted upon completing an Anime Guess round.

name.description: Player display name entered at game completion.

score.description: Final numeric score achieved in the round.

mode.description: Game mode played (Emoji, Anime, or Баатар).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the score was recorded.

/scores/{scoreId}.description: Stores immutable player score records for Anime Guess.
